<a id="op-roleclaim-getall"></a>
### GET `/api/identity/roleClaim`

operationId `RoleClaim_GetAll` · Retrieves all role claims in the system (e.g., Product Create Permission, User View Permission)

Parameters: _none_

Request body: _none_

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [ResultOfListOfRoleClaimResponse](#schema-resultoflistofroleclaimresponse) | Role claims retrieved successfully |
| `401` | [ProblemDetails](#schema-problemdetails) | Unauthorized - user must have RoleClaims.View permission |
| `500` | [Result](#schema-result) | Internal server error |

<a id="op-roleclaim-post"></a>
### POST `/api/identity/roleClaim`

operationId `RoleClaim_Post` · Creates a new role claim (permission) and assigns it to a role

Parameters: _none_

Request body `request` (application/json), **required**: [RoleClaimRequest](#schema-roleclaimrequest)

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [ResultOfString](#schema-resultofstring) | Role claim created successfully |
| `400` | [Result](#schema-result) | Invalid role claim data or claim already exists |
| `401` | [ProblemDetails](#schema-problemdetails) | Unauthorized - user must have RoleClaims.Create permission |
| `500` | [Result](#schema-result) | Internal server error |

### DELETE `/api/identity/roleClaim/{id}`

operationId `RoleClaim_Delete` · Deletes a role claim (permission) from the system

| Param | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | int32 | yes | The unique identifier of the role claim to delete |

Request body: _none_

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [ResultOfString](#schema-resultofstring) | Role claim deleted successfully |
| `401` | [ProblemDetails](#schema-problemdetails) | Unauthorized - user must have RoleClaims.Delete permission |
| `404` | [Result](#schema-result) | Role claim not found |
| `409` | [Result](#schema-result) | Role claim cannot be deleted due to existing dependencies |
| `500` | [Result](#schema-result) | Internal server error |
